notes: The design lays its right side out for a flank unwrapped like the Tatuus's,
flipped both ways. This car flips its right flank top to bottom only, so
these are the left side's rects mirrored through the measured axes.
On the left the fender and door are one island, which the number lands on;
the right has no such island, so its number goes on the door, at the same
place on the car as the left one.
